The gamer wears a black t-shirt, glasses, and a backward cap, maintaining a focused expression while a jungle environment is visible in-game. A permanent social media banner sits at the bottom. (2) Combat animations intensify with glowing spell effects as the gamer becomes more expressive, his mouth moving in rapid speech and eyes widening at the on-screen action. Game characters move across a river path. (3) The scene cuts to a larger view of the gamer reacting with frustration; he raises his hands and appears to strike the desk, his face displaying intense emotion with a wide-open mouth. (4) A rapid montage follows, alternating between game failure moments and the gamer rubbing his head in exasperation. Skill animations with vibrant purple and gold hues flash across the screen before the final reaction shot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker provides animated Mandarin commentary at a rapid pace over a light, upbeat synth BGM. A digital UI chime triggers a brief musical pause before the speaker's tone shifts to excitement. (2) A sharp impact sound, likely a desk hit, coincides with a rise in vocal intensity and strain as the BGM changes to dramatic orchestral strings. The speaker's pitch spikes as he reacts to the game. (3) Comedic sound effects, including a 'pop' and 'whistle', punctuate the speaker's shouting. The BGM cuts to absolute silence for one second to emphasize a frustrated exclamation before returning with a bouncy pop beat. (4) Frequent rhythmic slapping sounds overlay the speech as the arousal level remains high. The mix engineer has applied tight compression, though some digital clipping is audible during the loudest shouts before the track fades out.
